title: herpestis lanigera var. marginata
intro: Herpestis lanigera var. marginata, commonly known as Indian hyssop, is a perennial plant in the mint family (Lamiaceae) that is native to India. This plant is valued for its various health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antibacterial, and antifungal properties, which can help to soothe digestive issues, reduce fever, and alleviate respiratory problems. The therapeutic actions of Indian hyssop include its ability to calm the nervous system, relieve stress and anxiety, and promote a restful night's sleep. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties and make it a popular ingredient in traditional Indian medicine.
